description: This is a React component written in TypeScript which serves as the main page for a personal notes application. It manages fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes through API calls and renders other components like NoteList and Sidebar.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creating a new note, then refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles updating an existing note, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deleting a note, then refreshes the list.
